description: Regione Campania publishes a fuel-distribution network inventory associated with its regional network rationalisation plan. The native catalogue lists CSV and JSON distributions whose names both identify installations in 2002. The resource describes fuel-supply infrastructure and can provide a historical asset baseline for capacity and distribution-network planning. It does not establish current station operation, fuel-storage capacity or present demand. The short metadata does not provide the full field dictionary, geolocation precision or the plan's adoption date. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The native CKAN metadata endpoint is the verified access route; an attempted browser landing URL returned HTTP 404 and is not used as the record homepage. A caveat is that the 2002 label comes from the distribution metadata, not from inspected file values. No directly related resource is established by the source.
